a mobile real-time transaction can be executed in a real-time manner, even when the mobile host is disconnected from the fixed network.
we have proposed a multi-version data management model and an image transaction model to support the execution of real-time transactions under a mobile environment.

the proposed data model can significantly reduce the data access latency and improve the data availability for real-time transactions, and the proposed image transaction model can reduce the transaction restart overheads and minimize the impacts of the mobile network on transaction execution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a multi-version data access model for real-time transactions in mobile environments.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of a multi-version data management scheme for processing real-time transactions in an unpredictable mobile environment.
how to reduce the impacts on the transaction processing of mobile network failures and how to reduce the access delay of remote data in a mobile environment.

our model is a promising solution for executing real-time transaction in a mobile environment.
the proposed model is an effective approach to reduce the data-access delay and to enhance the performance of real-time transactions.

our multi-version data model is able to reduce the impacts caused by unpredictable and unreliable mobile networks on processing of real-time mobile transactions, and it is able to enhance the availability and reliability of the mobile transactions in a mobile computing environment.

the proposed multi-version data model can be used to support real-time transaction processing in a mobile environment and that the image transaction model can be applied to reduce the data-access delays and to simplify the real-time transactions management.
the multi-version data model can significantly improve the data availability and the transaction success ratio in a mobile environment with unreliable and unpredictable network.

the proposed multi-version data model, which is based on the relative consistency, can effectively reduce the impacts of the unreliable network on real-time transactions, and the proposed image transaction model can reduce the data access delays and the transaction-restart time, and can simplify the processing of the real-times transactions in a mobile network.
